professional.summary.title: SUMMARY
professional.summary.body:
Global localization expert, game producer, and project manager with extensive international experience leading multicultural teams through successful production cycles. Skilled in optimizing processes, implementing best practices, proactively identifying risk, and unblocking issues to create successful products and experiences while fostering a workplace that values accountability and honesty.

Fluent in Chinese (Mandarin) and known for working with diverse multinational teams, serving as a trusted liaison with international partners and IP stakeholders while maintaining clarity, accountability, momentum, and cultural respect.

professional.experience.mrbeast.title: Localization Program Manager
professional.experience.mrbeast.summary: Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast. With over 500 million subscribers, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube.
professional.experience.mrbeast.bullet1: Ran standup for 7-person leadership team 3 times a week to drive results, track milestone progress, reprioritize work, and quickly address critical issues and bottlenecks
professional.experience.mrbeast.bullet2: Managed weekly content intake cycles between Production and Localization for 7 channels, including the main YouTube channel, shortform content, and advertising for branding partners
professional.experience.mrbeast.bullet3: Owned project communications with Production and vendors dubbing video content in 20+ languages within a 5-day turnaround and expected $100,000+ weekly budget
professional.experience.mrbeast.bullet4: Resolved last-minute change requests including transcript edits, formatting issues, and licensing concerns to meet deadlines amidst shifting production schedules
professional.experience.mrbeast.bullet5: Created new tools with Claude AI to streamline repetitive, time sensitive, and high-risk workflows
professional.experience.mrbeast.bullet6: Researched and implemented new transcription platform and onboarding materials to increase team efficiency and ability to meet exceedingly tight deadlines
professional.experience.mrbeast.bullet7: Planned and executed multiple rounds of localized audio, video, and subtitle LQA for commercial advertising projects
professional.experience.twoK.title: Mobile Producer
professional.experience.twoK.summary: I acted as both Mobile Producer and Senior Localization Producer for a mobile title within a AAA franchise first released in 2024. I partnered with the Executive Producer and global project teams to successfully launch and run live operations in multiple regions. I owned the localization pipeline and optimized it with new tooling, supported project work for multiple teams, and increased player performance by ensuring a culturally relevant and high-quality experience for players.
professional.experience.twoK.bullet1: Owned $500,000 localization and culturalization pipelines including text translation, voiceover script writing, recording sessions, and art reviews for cultural sensitivity and historical accuracy
professional.experience.twoK.bullet2: Designed multilingual documentation processes with automated updates to support multidisciplinary teams, saving $100,000 on retranslation costs
professional.experience.twoK.bullet3: Onboarded Gridly, a new CMS, TMS, and CAT tool, to create and implement modernized mobile-first localization workflows with custom automations, thereby reducing manual hand-offs and risk while increasing process reliability
professional.experience.twoK.bullet4: Triaged and implemented 10,000+ fixes with China-based LQA/FQA teams and external development studio to address live player concerns and in-game performance
professional.experience.twoK.bullet5: Improved LQA processes with localization, QA, and development teams to increase efficiency and bug burndown rates while reducing version control errors
professional.experience.twoK.bullet6: Directly managed and increased the game's English translation quality to create a native-level experience for players, meeting expectations for a AAA title and reducing negative feedback
professional.experience.twoK.bullet7: Supported Live Ops and weekly updates to increase release confidence and quality
professional.experience.twoK.bullet8: Executed alpha and soft launches to analyze market performance and identify new opportunities for future releases
professional.experience.twoK.bullet9: Designed and implemented feature specs for legal compliance, including GDPR and DSAR, to reduce legal risk and ensure compliance with local and international laws
